        echo OLD_SOURCE: MOVED_POST_CUTOVER >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
    ) else (
        echo    [WARN] Old source missing package.json at %OLD_SOURCE%
        echo OLD_SOURCE: WARN_MISSING >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
    )
)

echo.
echo 3. Checking Local Destination (%LOCAL_DEST%)...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] Local destination exists and contains package.json (Staged/Active).
    echo LOCAL_DEST: CONTAINS_PACKAGE >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
) else (
    echo    [INFO] Local destination is empty or ready for staging.
    echo LOCAL_DEST: EMPTY_OR_READY >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
)

echo.
echo 4. Checking D: Drive Free Space...
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d = Get-PSDrive D; [PSCustomObject]@{ Drive='D:'; 'Free(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Free/1GB,2); 'Used(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Used/1GB,2) } | Format-Table -AutoSize"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d = Get-PSDrive D; [PSCustomObject]@{ Drive='D:'; 'Free(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Free/1GB,2); 'Used(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Used/1GB,2) }" >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"

echo.
echo 5. Active OmniRoute Processes:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table ProcessId, Name, CommandLine -AutoSize"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize" >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"

echo.
echo Diagnostic report written to:
echo %AUDIT_LOG%
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [2] STAGE PACKAGE TO LOCAL D:
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_STAGE
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [2] STAGE PACKAGE TO LOCAL D: (NON-DESTRUCTIVE)
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Source     : %OLD_SOURCE%
echo Destination: %LOCAL_DEST%
echo.
echo NOTE: This operation is 100%% safe to run while OmniRoute is actively running.
echo It copies files to local storage without touching your C: junction or Drive folder.
echo.

if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Source package not found at: %OLD_SOURCE%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

set /p "PROCEED_STAGE=Start staging copy now? (Y/N): "
if /i not "%PROCEED_STAGE%"=="Y" goto MAIN_MENU

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%" mkdir "%LOCAL_DEST%"

echo.
echo Running robocopy mirror to local destination...
echo Log: %LOG_FILE%
echo.

robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"

REM Robocopy error levels 0-7 indicate successful copy operations
if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Robocopy encountered critical errors. Exit code: %RC_ERR%
    echo Check log: %LOG_FILE%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo Verifying staged files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
        echo [OK] Verified core files present in local destination.
        echo STATE=STAGED > "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo LAST_STAGED=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo.
        echo [+] Staging completed successfully. State updated to STAGED.
        echo [!] OmniRoute and Faust are still running normally.
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] Staged files verification failed: bin\omniroute.mjs missing!
    )
) else (
    echo [ERROR] Staged files verification failed: package.json missing!
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [3] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_STOP
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [3] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo WARNING: Stopping OmniRoute will disconnect Faust's live terminal connection.
echo You will use this standalone batch console to complete Cutover and Verify,
echo then restart OmniRoute via Option 6 to re-awaken Faust.
echo.
echo Current Port %PORT% Status: %PORT_STATUS%
echo Active OmniRoute Processes : %PROC_COUNT%
echo.

if "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="CLOSED" (
        echo OmniRoute is ALREADY STOPPED. No termination required.
        echo STATE=STOPPED > "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    )
)

set /p "CONFIRM_STOP=Stop OmniRoute service now? (Y/N): "
if /i not "%CONFIRM_STOP%"=="Y" goto MAIN_MENU

echo.
echo Terminating OmniRoute process tree via PID tracker...
if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do (
        echo Killing tracked PID: %%i
        taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
    )
    del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
)

echo Sweeping remaining listeners on Port %PORT%...
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

timeout /t 2 >nul

REM Verify stopped
set "CHECK_PORT=CLOSED"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "CHECK_PORT=%%o"

if "%CHECK_PORT%"=="CLOSED" (
    echo.
    echo [+] OmniRoute service terminated cleanly. Port %PORT% is closed.
    echo STATE=STOPPED > "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Port %PORT% still appears active. Please inspect Task Manager if needed.
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [4] EXECUTE CUTOVER
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_CUTOVER
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [4] EXECUTE CUTOVER (CRITICAL CUTOVER STEP)
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Prerequisites:
echo   1. Staging must have completed successfully.
echo   2. OmniRoute service must be stopped (Zero active locks).
echo.

REM Verify processes are dead
if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
    echo [ERROR] Port %PORT% is still LISTENING!
    echo You must stop OmniRoute (Option 3) before cutting over.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

if not "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    echo [WARN] Detected %PROC_COUNT% OmniRoute process(es) still running!
    echo It is strongly advised to stop them first to avoid locked-file errors.
    echo.
)

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Local destination has not been staged! Run Option 2 first.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

REM Verify C: junction currently points to OLD_SOURCE
if not "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%OLD_SOURCE%" (
    if "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
        echo [INFO] C: Junction is ALREADY targeting Local Destination.
        echo Cutover has already been executed! Run Option 5 to verify.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] C: Junction target does not match expected old source!
        echo Expected: %OLD_SOURCE%
        echo Current : %CURRENT_TARGET%
        echo Aborting cutover to protect existing filesystem state.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    )
)

echo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo Cutover Sequence will perform:
echo   1. Final fast delta robocopy to catch any newly modified files.
echo   2. Move '%OLD_SOURCE%' to local rollback folder.
echo      (Outside Google Drive sync - safe on local D: disk).
echo   3. Remove C: junction (using safe bare rmdir).
echo   4. Recreate C: junction targeting '%LOCAL_DEST%'.
echo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo.
echo To confirm and proceed, type exactly: MOVE OMNIROUTE PACKAGE
set /p "CUT_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%CUT_PHRASE%"=="MOVE OMNIROUTE PACKAGE" (
    echo.
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. No changes made.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [Step 1/4] Running final delta robocopy...
robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo [ERROR] Final delta copy failed with code %RC_ERR%. Aborting before junction change!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [Step 2/4] Moving old Drive source to local rollback folder...
if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
    echo [ERROR] Rollback directory already exists: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo Please inspect or clean prior rollback before moving.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

move "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to move old Drive package into rollback folder!
    echo Possible file lock. Aborting cutover before touching C: junction.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)
echo    [OK] Old source moved to: %ROLLBACK_DIR%

echo.
echo [Step 3/4] Safely removing old C: junction (bare rmdir)...
rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to remove C: junction!
    echo Attempting to restore old source from rollback...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)
echo    [OK] Old junction removed.

echo.
echo [Step 4/4] Creating new C: junction to Local Destination...
mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%LOCAL_DEST%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] mklink failed! Attempting emergency restoration...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    echo Please inspect system permissions.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

REM Verify newly created link
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_TARGET=%%t"

if "%NEW_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
    echo.
    echo ==============================================================================
    echo [+] CUTOVER COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!
    echo     C: Junction now points to: %NEW_TARGET%
    echo     Old package preserved at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo ==============================================================================
    echo STATE=CUTOVER_COMPLETE > "%STATE_FILE%"
    echo CUTOVER_TIME=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Cutover completed, but target check reported: %NEW_TARGET%
)

echo.
echo Proceed to Option 5 (Verify Integrity) before starting OmniRoute.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [5] VERIFY CUTOVER INTEGRITY
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_VERIFY
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [5] VERIFY CUTOVER STATIC INTEGRITY
echo ==============================================================================
echo.

echo 1. Checking C: Junction target...
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "V_TARGET=%%t"
if "%V_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
    echo    [OK] C: Junction correctly targets: %V_TARGET%
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] C: Junction targets: %V_TARGET% (Expected: %LOCAL_DEST%)
)

echo.
echo 2. Checking Local Package Essential Files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] package.json exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] package.json missing!
)

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
    echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] bin\omniroute.mjs missing!
)

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\node_modules" (
    echo    [OK] node_modules directory exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] node_modules missing!
)

echo.
echo 3. Checking Node.js runtime availability...
where node >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    for /f "delims=" %%v in ('node -v 2^>nul') do echo    [OK] Node.js is available: %%v
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Node executable not found in PATH.
)

echo.
echo 4. Performing Node static syntax check on omniroute.mjs...
node --check "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs passed Node syntax verification without errors.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] bin\omniroute.mjs failed syntax check!
)

echo.
echo 5. Checking Old Drive Source absence...
if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%" (
    echo    [OK] Old source is absent from Google Drive sync folder.
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Old source folder still exists at %OLD_SOURCE%
)

echo.
echo 6. Checking Rollback Backup preservation...
if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] Full rollback backup is intact at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Rollback backup not found at %ROLLBACK_DIR%
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo VERIFICATION SUMMARY:
echo If all checks above are [OK], you can safely launch OmniRoute (Option 6)
echo to re-establish Faust's terminal connection.
echo If any checks failed, select Option 7 (Roll Back).
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [6] START OMNIROUTE SERVICE
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_START
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [6] START OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Starting OmniRoute via standard launcher:
echo %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
echo.

if not exist "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%" (
    echo [ERROR] Launcher shortcut not found: %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

call "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%"

echo.
echo Waiting 5 seconds for service listener to bind...
timeout /t 5 >nul

for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_PORT_STATUS=%%o"

if "%NEW_PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
    echo.
    echo [+] OmniRoute is successfully LISTENING on Port %PORT%!
    echo [+] Faust connection should now be fully restored.
    echo STATE=VERIFIED > "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Port %PORT% has not opened yet. Check logs at: %PID_DIR%\omniroute_err.log
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [7] ROLL BACK TO ORIGINAL SETUP
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_ROLLBACK
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [7] EMERGENCY ROLLBACK TO ORIGINAL SETUP
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo This operation will:
echo   1. Remove the local C: junction.
echo   2. Move the original package back from rollback to '%OLD_SOURCE%'.
echo   3. Recreate the C: junction pointing back to '%OLD_SOURCE%'.
echo.

if not exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Rollback backup not found at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo Cannot execute automated rollback without intact backup!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo To confirm emergency rollback, type exactly: CONFIRM ROLLBACK
set /p "RB_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%RB_PHRASE%"=="CONFIRM ROLLBACK" (
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. Rollback cancelled.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [1/4] Stopping any active OmniRoute processes...
if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
    del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
)
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

echo [2/4] Removing current C: junction (bare rmdir)...
rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%" >nul 2>&1

echo [3/4] Moving package from rollback back to Google Drive source...
move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to move package back to %OLD_SOURCE%!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo [4/4] Restoring original C: junction...
mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to recreate original junction!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo [+] ROLLBACK COMPLETED!
echo     Original source restored: %OLD_SOURCE%
echo     C: junction retargeted back to original source.
echo ==============================================================================
echo STATE=ROLLED_BACK > "%STATE_FILE%"
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [8] FINALIZE (DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP)
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_FINALIZE
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [8] FINALIZE & DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo WARNING: This permanently deletes the preserved rollback copy at:
echo %ROLLBACK_DIR%
echo.
echo This operation should ONLY be performed after OmniRoute and Faust
echo have been running stably on the new local master for AT LEAST 48 HOURS.
echo.

if not exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
    echo [INFO] No rollback directory exists. System is already finalized.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo To permanently delete the rollback backup, type exactly: DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP
set /p "FIN_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%FIN_PHRASE%"=="DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP" (
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. Finalization cancelled.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo Deleting rollback backup...
rmdir /S /Q "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to delete rollback directory.
) else (
    echo [+] Rollback backup deleted cleanly.
    echo STATE=FINALIZED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    echo FINALIZED_TIME=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [0] EXIT
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_EXIT
echo Exiting OmniRoute Migration Console.
exit /b 0

@echo off

REM ==============================================================================

:MAIN_MENU

    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LinkType" 2^>nul`) do set "CURRENT_LINKTYPE=%%t"
)

REM --- Check Active OmniRoute Processes ---
set "PROC_COUNT=0"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%p in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' }).Count" 2^>nul`) do set "PROC_COUNT=%%p"

REM --- Check Port 20128 ---
set "PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "PORT_STATUS=%%o"

echo  [STATE]: %STATE%
echo  [C: JUNCTION]: %C_JUNCTION%
echo  [LINK TYPE]  : %CURRENT_LINKTYPE%
echo  [TARGET]     : %CURRENT_TARGET%
echo  [SERVICE]    : Port %PORT% is %PORT_STATUS% (OmniRoute processes: %PROC_COUNT%)
echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo  WORKFLOW STEPS (Follow in exact order):
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo   [1] Audit & System Health Preflight
echo   [2] Stage Full Package to Local D:     (SAFE - Run while OmniRoute is active)
echo   [3] Stop OmniRoute Service             (Prepares for Cutover - Faust sleeps)
echo   [4] Execute Cutover                    (Delta Sync + Rollback Move + Retarget C:)
echo   [5] Verify Cutover Static Integrity    (Validates syntax & junction target)
echo   [6] Start OmniRoute Service            (Wakes Faust back up on new local master)
echo.
echo  EMERGENCY & LIFECYCLE CONTROLS:
echo   [7] Roll Back to Original Drive Setup  (Emergency Restore if startup fails)
echo   [8] Finalize & Delete Rollback Backup  (Run ONLY after 48h+ of stable operation)
echo   [0] Exit Console
echo.
echo ==============================================================================
set /p "CHOICE=Select an option [0-8]: "

if "%CHOICE%"=="1" goto OP_AUDIT
if "%CHOICE%"=="2" goto OP_STAGE
if "%CHOICE%"=="3" goto OP_STOP
if "%CHOICE%"=="4" goto OP_CUTOVER
if "%CHOICE%"=="5" goto OP_VERIFY
if "%CHOICE%"=="6" goto OP_START
if "%CHOICE%"=="7" goto OP_ROLLBACK
if "%CHOICE%"=="8" goto OP_FINALIZE
if "%CHOICE%"=="0" goto OP_EXIT

echo Invalid selection. Please choose 0 through 8.
timeout /t 2 >nul
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [1] AUDIT PREFLIGHT
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_AUDIT
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [1] AUDIT PREFLIGHT & DIAGNOSTIC REPORT
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
set "AUDIT_LOG=%LOG_DIR%\audit_%DATE:~10,4%%DATE:~4,2%%DATE:~7,2%_%TIME:~0,2%%TIME:~3,2%%TIME:~6,2%.log"
set "AUDIT_LOG=%AUDIT_LOG: =0%"

echo Starting diagnostic sweep at %DATE% %TIME%...
echo === AUDIT LOG: %DATE% %TIME% === >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"

echo.
echo 1. Checking C: Junction...
if exist "%C_JUNCTION%" (
    echo    [OK] Path exists: %C_JUNCTION%
    echo    [OK] LinkType: %CURRENT_LINKTYPE%
    echo    [OK] Target  : %CURRENT_TARGET%
    echo C_JUNCTION: EXISTS | LinkType: %CURRENT_LINKTYPE% | Target: %CURRENT_TARGET% >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
) else (
    echo    [ERROR] C: Junction path missing!
    echo C_JUNCTION: MISSING >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
)

echo.
echo 2. Checking Old Drive Source (%OLD_SOURCE%)...
if exist "%OLD_SOURCE%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] Old source exists with package.json
    echo OLD_SOURCE: OK >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
) else (
    if "%STATE%"=="CUTOVER_COMPLETE" (
        echo    [INFO] Old source already moved out of Drive sync (as expected post-cutover).
        echo OLD_SOURCE: MOVED_POST_CUTOVER >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
    ) else (
        echo    [WARN] Old source missing package.json at %OLD_SOURCE%
        echo OLD_SOURCE: WARN_MISSING >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
    )
)

echo.
echo 3. Checking Local Destination (%LOCAL_DEST%)...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] Local destination exists and contains package.json (Staged/Active).
    echo LOCAL_DEST: CONTAINS_PACKAGE >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
) else (
    echo    [INFO] Local destination is empty or ready for staging.
    echo LOCAL_DEST: EMPTY_OR_READY >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"
)

echo.
echo 4. Checking D: Drive Free Space...
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d = Get-PSDrive D; [PSCustomObject]@{ Drive='D:'; 'Free(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Free/1GB,2); 'Used(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Used/1GB,2) } | Format-Table -AutoSize"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$d = Get-PSDrive D; [PSCustomObject]@{ Drive='D:'; 'Free(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Free/1GB,2); 'Used(GB)'=[math]::Round($d.Used/1GB,2) }" >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"

echo.
echo 5. Active OmniRoute Processes:
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table ProcessId, Name, CommandLine -AutoSize"
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' } | Select-Object ProcessId, Name, CommandLine | Format-Table -AutoSize" >> "%AUDIT_LOG%"

echo.
echo Diagnostic report written to:
echo %AUDIT_LOG%
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [2] STAGE PACKAGE TO LOCAL D:
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_STAGE
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [2] STAGE PACKAGE TO LOCAL D: (NON-DESTRUCTIVE)
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Source     : %OLD_SOURCE%
echo Destination: %LOCAL_DEST%
echo.
echo NOTE: This operation is 100%% safe to run while OmniRoute is actively running.
echo It copies files to local storage without touching your C: junction or Drive folder.
echo.

if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Source package not found at: %OLD_SOURCE%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

set /p "PROCEED_STAGE=Start staging copy now? (Y/N): "
if /i not "%PROCEED_STAGE%"=="Y" goto MAIN_MENU

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%" mkdir "%LOCAL_DEST%"

echo.
echo Running robocopy mirror to local destination...
echo Log: %LOG_FILE%
echo.

robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"

REM Robocopy error levels 0-7 indicate successful copy operations
if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Robocopy encountered critical errors. Exit code: %RC_ERR%
    echo Check log: %LOG_FILE%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo Verifying staged files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
        echo [OK] Verified core files present in local destination.
        echo STATE=STAGED > "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo LAST_STAGED=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo.
        echo [+] Staging completed successfully. State updated to STAGED.
        echo [!] OmniRoute and Faust are still running normally.
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] Staged files verification failed: bin\omniroute.mjs missing!
    )
) else (
    echo [ERROR] Staged files verification failed: package.json missing!
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [3] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_STOP
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [3] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo WARNING: Stopping OmniRoute will disconnect Faust's live terminal connection.
echo You will use this standalone batch console to complete Cutover and Verify,
echo then restart OmniRoute via Option 6 to re-awaken Faust.
echo.
echo Current Port %PORT% Status: %PORT_STATUS%
echo Active OmniRoute Processes : %PROC_COUNT%
echo.

if "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="CLOSED" (
        echo OmniRoute is ALREADY STOPPED. No termination required.
        echo STATE=STOPPED > "%STATE_FILE%"
        echo.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    )
)

set /p "CONFIRM_STOP=Stop OmniRoute service now? (Y/N): "
if /i not "%CONFIRM_STOP%"=="Y" goto MAIN_MENU

echo.
echo Terminating OmniRoute process tree via PID tracker...
if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do (
        echo Killing tracked PID: %%i
        taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
    )
    del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
)

echo Sweeping remaining listeners on Port %PORT%...
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

timeout /t 2 >nul

REM Verify stopped
set "CHECK_PORT=CLOSED"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "CHECK_PORT=%%o"

if "%CHECK_PORT%"=="CLOSED" (
    echo.
    echo [+] OmniRoute service terminated cleanly. Port %PORT% is closed.
    echo STATE=STOPPED > "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Port %PORT% still appears active. Please inspect Task Manager if needed.
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [4] EXECUTE CUTOVER
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_CUTOVER
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [4] EXECUTE CUTOVER (CRITICAL CUTOVER STEP)
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Prerequisites:
echo   1. Staging must have completed successfully.
echo   2. OmniRoute service must be stopped (Zero active locks).
echo.

REM Verify processes are dead
if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
    echo [ERROR] Port %PORT% is still LISTENING!
    echo You must stop OmniRoute (Option 3) before cutting over.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

if not "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    echo [WARN] Detected %PROC_COUNT% OmniRoute process(es) still running!
    echo It is strongly advised to stop them first to avoid locked-file errors.
    echo.
)

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Local destination has not been staged! Run Option 2 first.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

REM Verify C: junction currently points to OLD_SOURCE
if not "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%OLD_SOURCE%" (
    if "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
        echo [INFO] C: Junction is ALREADY targeting Local Destination.
        echo Cutover has already been executed! Run Option 5 to verify.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] C: Junction target does not match expected old source!
        echo Expected: %OLD_SOURCE%
        echo Current : %CURRENT_TARGET%
        echo Aborting cutover to protect existing filesystem state.
        pause
        goto MAIN_MENU
    )
)

echo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo Cutover Sequence will perform:
echo   1. Final fast delta robocopy to catch any newly modified files.
echo   2. Move '%OLD_SOURCE%' to local rollback folder.
echo      (Outside Google Drive sync - safe on local D: disk).
echo   3. Remove C: junction (using safe bare rmdir).
echo   4. Recreate C: junction targeting '%LOCAL_DEST%'.
echo ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
echo.
echo To confirm and proceed, type exactly: MOVE OMNIROUTE PACKAGE
set /p "CUT_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%CUT_PHRASE%"=="MOVE OMNIROUTE PACKAGE" (
    echo.
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. No changes made.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [Step 1/4] Running final delta robocopy...
robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo [ERROR] Final delta copy failed with code %RC_ERR%. Aborting before junction change!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [Step 2/4] Moving old Drive source to local rollback folder...
if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
    echo [ERROR] Rollback directory already exists: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo Please inspect or clean prior rollback before moving.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

move "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to move old Drive package into rollback folder!
    echo Possible file lock. Aborting cutover before touching C: junction.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)
echo    [OK] Old source moved to: %ROLLBACK_DIR%

echo.
echo [Step 3/4] Safely removing old C: junction (bare rmdir)...
rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to remove C: junction!
    echo Attempting to restore old source from rollback...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)
echo    [OK] Old junction removed.

echo.
echo [Step 4/4] Creating new C: junction to Local Destination...
mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%LOCAL_DEST%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] mklink failed! Attempting emergency restoration...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    echo Please inspect system permissions.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

REM Verify newly created link
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_TARGET=%%t"

if "%NEW_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
    echo.
    echo ==============================================================================
    echo [+] CUTOVER COMPLETED SUCCESSFULLY!
    echo     C: Junction now points to: %NEW_TARGET%
    echo     Old package preserved at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo ==============================================================================
    echo STATE=CUTOVER_COMPLETE > "%STATE_FILE%"
    echo CUTOVER_TIME=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Cutover completed, but target check reported: %NEW_TARGET%
)

echo.
echo Proceed to Option 5 (Verify Integrity) before starting OmniRoute.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [5] VERIFY CUTOVER INTEGRITY
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_VERIFY
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [5] VERIFY CUTOVER STATIC INTEGRITY
echo ==============================================================================
echo.

echo 1. Checking C: Junction target...
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "V_TARGET=%%t"
if "%V_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
    echo    [OK] C: Junction correctly targets: %V_TARGET%
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] C: Junction targets: %V_TARGET% (Expected: %LOCAL_DEST%)
)

echo.
echo 2. Checking Local Package Essential Files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] package.json exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] package.json missing!
)

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
    echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] bin\omniroute.mjs missing!
)

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\node_modules" (
    echo    [OK] node_modules directory exists.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] node_modules missing!
)

echo.
echo 3. Checking Node.js runtime availability...
where node >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    for /f "delims=" %%v in ('node -v 2^>nul') do echo    [OK] Node.js is available: %%v
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Node executable not found in PATH.
)

echo.
echo 4. Performing Node static syntax check on omniroute.mjs...
node --check "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs passed Node syntax verification without errors.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] bin\omniroute.mjs failed syntax check!
)

echo.
echo 5. Checking Old Drive Source absence...
if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%" (
    echo    [OK] Old source is absent from Google Drive sync folder.
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Old source folder still exists at %OLD_SOURCE%
)

echo.
echo 6. Checking Rollback Backup preservation...
if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%\package.json" (
    echo    [OK] Full rollback backup is intact at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Rollback backup not found at %ROLLBACK_DIR%
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo VERIFICATION SUMMARY:
echo If all checks above are [OK], you can safely launch OmniRoute (Option 6)
echo to re-establish Faust's terminal connection.
echo If any checks failed, select Option 7 (Roll Back).
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [6] START OMNIROUTE SERVICE
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_START
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [6] START OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Starting OmniRoute via standard launcher:
echo %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
echo.

if not exist "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%" (
    echo [ERROR] Launcher shortcut not found: %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

call "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%"

echo.
echo Waiting 5 seconds for service listener to bind...
timeout /t 5 >nul

for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_PORT_STATUS=%%o"

if "%NEW_PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
    echo.
    echo [+] OmniRoute is successfully LISTENING on Port %PORT%!
    echo [+] Faust connection should now be fully restored.
    echo STATE=VERIFIED > "%STATE_FILE%"
) else (
    echo.
    echo [WARN] Port %PORT% has not opened yet. Check logs at: %PID_DIR%\omniroute_err.log
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [7] ROLL BACK TO ORIGINAL SETUP
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_ROLLBACK
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [7] EMERGENCY ROLLBACK TO ORIGINAL SETUP
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo This operation will:
echo   1. Remove the local C: junction.
echo   2. Move the original package back from rollback to '%OLD_SOURCE%'.
echo   3. Recreate the C: junction pointing back to '%OLD_SOURCE%'.
echo.

if not exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%\package.json" (
    echo [ERROR] Rollback backup not found at: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo Cannot execute automated rollback without intact backup!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo To confirm emergency rollback, type exactly: CONFIRM ROLLBACK
set /p "RB_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%RB_PHRASE%"=="CONFIRM ROLLBACK" (
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. Rollback cancelled.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo [1/4] Stopping any active OmniRoute processes...
if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
    del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
)
powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

echo [2/4] Removing current C: junction (bare rmdir)...
rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%" >nul 2>&1

echo [3/4] Moving package from rollback back to Google Drive source...
move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to move package back to %OLD_SOURCE%!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo [4/4] Restoring original C: junction...
mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [CRITICAL ERROR] Failed to recreate original junction!
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo [+] ROLLBACK COMPLETED!
echo     Original source restored: %OLD_SOURCE%
echo     C: junction retargeted back to original source.
echo ==============================================================================
echo STATE=ROLLED_BACK > "%STATE_FILE%"
echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [8] FINALIZE (DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP)
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_FINALIZE
cls
echo ==============================================================================
echo   [8] FINALIZE & DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo WARNING: This permanently deletes the preserved rollback copy at:
echo %ROLLBACK_DIR%
echo.
echo This operation should ONLY be performed after OmniRoute and Faust
echo have been running stably on the new local master for AT LEAST 48 HOURS.
echo.

if not exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
    echo [INFO] No rollback directory exists. System is already finalized.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo To permanently delete the rollback backup, type exactly: DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP
set /p "FIN_PHRASE=Confirmation phrase: "
if not "%FIN_PHRASE%"=="DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP" (
    echo [ABORT] Confirmation phrase did not match. Finalization cancelled.
    pause
    goto MAIN_MENU
)

echo.
echo Deleting rollback backup...
rmdir /S /Q "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to delete rollback directory.
) else (
    echo [+] Rollback backup deleted cleanly.
    echo STATE=FINALIZED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    echo FINALIZED_TIME=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"
)

echo.
pause
goto MAIN_MENU

REM ==============================================================================
REM   [0] EXIT
REM ==============================================================================
:OP_EXIT
echo Exiting OmniRoute Migration Console.
exit /b 0

@echo off
setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion
title OmniRoute Phase 1 Migration Console

REM ==============================================================================
REM   OmniRoute Phase 1 Migration & Emergency Recovery Console
REM   Architecture: Local Master on D: (Sovereign) | Zero App Code in Drive Sync
REM   Location: D:\My Drive\Blue AI\OmniRoute-Phase1.bat
REM ==============================================================================

set "PROJECT_ROOT=D:\My Drive\Blue AI"

set "LOG_FILE=%LOG_DIR%\migration.log"

:MAIN_MENU

    for /f "tokens=2 delims==" %%a in ('findstr /i "STATE=" "%STATE_FILE%" 2^>nul') do set "STATE=%%a"
)

REM --- Inspect Current Junction Target ---

if "%CHOICE%"=="1" goto OP_AUDIT

Manager, I've created the **OmniRoute Phase 1 Migration Console** batch file at:

**`D:\My Drive\Blue AI\OmniRoute-Phase1.bat`**

This is your complete offline recovery tool for migrating the OmniRoute application package from Drive sync to local D: storage.

## What it contains

**8 menu-driven operations:**

1. **Audit & System Health Preflight** — Read-only diagnostic sweep (junction targets, disk space, process detection, required files)
2. **Stage Full Package to Local D:** — Safe initial copy while OmniRoute is running (non-destructive)
3. **Stop OmniRoute Service** — Terminates OmniRoute cleanly (puts Faust to sleep)
4. **Execute Cutover** — Final delta sync, moves old Drive package to rollback, retargets C: junction
5. **Verify Cutover Static Integrity** — Validates junction target, required files, Node syntax check
6. **Start OmniRoute Service** — Launches OmniRoute from new local location (wakes Faust)
7. **Roll Back to Original Drive Setup** — Emergency restore if startup fails
8. **Finalize & Delete Rollback Backup** — Cleanup after 48+ hours of stable operation

## Key safety features

- **Stateful workflow** — Tracks progress in `state.ini`, only permits valid transitions
- **Exact target validation** — Every junction operation verifies the exact expected path before proceeding
- **Confirmation phrases required** — Cutover requires typing `MOVE OMNIROUTE PACKAGE`, rollback requires `CONFIRM ROLLBACK`, finalize requires `DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP`
- **Rollback preservation** — Old package is moved (not deleted) to `D:\My System\Local App Junction\OmniRoute-Phase1-Recovery\rollback\omniroute-original\`
- **Bare `rmdir` for junctions** — Never uses `/S /Q`, so cannot accidentally delete junction targets
- **Detailed logging** — All operations log to `%RECOVERY_DIR%\logs\`

## How to use it

1. **Right now** (while Faust is online): Run the batch file, select Option 1 (Audit), then Option 2 (Stage copy)
2. **When ready to cut over**: Run Option 3 (Stop), then Option 4 (Cutover), then Option 5 (Verify)
3. **Wake Faust**: Run Option 6 (Start) — OmniRoute launches from the new local path
4. **If startup fails**: Run Option 7 (Roll Back) to restore the original Drive setup
5. **After 48+ hours stable**: Run Option 8 (Finalize) to delete the rollback backup

The console is entirely self-contained and works without Faust being online. Ready when you are, Manager.

content.text:
Great question, Manager. Let me think through which steps actually **require** OmniRoute to be stopped:

| Step | Requires Stop? | Why |
|------|---|---|
| **1. Audit** | ❌ NO | Read-only inspection, doesn't touch anything |
| **2. Stage copy** | ❌ NO | `robocopy` can copy while files are in use (just won't catch live-written changes mid-copy) |
| **3. Stop OmniRoute** | ✅ YES | Obviously |
| **4. Execute cutover** | ✅ **MAYBE** | Only if files are being actively written during the final delta copy. If OmniRoute is already stopped, this is safe. |
| **5. Verify** | ❌ NO | Static checks only |
| **6. Start OmniRoute** | ❌ NO | Launch from new location |
| **7. Roll back** | ✅ YES | Must stop it first to avoid file locks |
| **8. Finalize** | ❌ NO | Just deletes old backup |

**The critical step is the junction retarget (Step 4):** We need OmniRoute stopped before we change the C: junction, otherwise:
- The process might have an open file handle through the old C: path
- After we retarget the junction, those handles could break
- The running process could crash or behave unpredictably

**However**, we could optimize this:
1. Run Audit + Stage copy **while OmniRoute is running** (safe, non-destructive)
2. **Then** stop OmniRoute normally
3. Run Cutover + Verify (fast, since most files are already copied)
4. Start OmniRoute on new location

This **minimizes downtime** — OmniRoute only stops for the actual junction cutover, not for the slow initial copy.

@echo off
setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion
title OmniRoute Phase 1 Migration Console

REM ==============================================================================
REM   OmniRoute Phase 1: Linear Execution - Only Pause on Fallback
REM ==============================================================================

set "PROJECT_ROOT=D:\My Drive\Blue AI"
set "OLD_SOURCE=D:\My Drive\Sync\omniroute"
set "LOCAL_DEST=D:\My System\Local App Junction\OmniRoute"
set "C_JUNCTION=C:\Users\Admin\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\omniroute"
set "RECOVERY_DIR=D:\My System\Local App Junction\OmniRoute-Phase1-Recovery"
set "ROLLBACK_DIR=%RECOVERY_DIR%\rollback\omniroute-original"
set "LOG_DIR=%RECOVERY_DIR%\logs"
set "STATE_FILE=%RECOVERY_DIR%\state.ini"
set "OMNI_SHORTCUT=%PROJECT_ROOT%\ZZ - Shortcuts\OmniRoute.bat"
set "PID_DIR=%TEMP%\OmniRoute"
set "PORT=20128"

REM --- Create Recovery Structure ---
if not exist "%RECOVERY_DIR%" mkdir "%RECOVERY_DIR%"
if not exist "%LOG_DIR%" mkdir "%LOG_DIR%"
if not exist "%RECOVERY_DIR%\rollback" mkdir "%RECOVERY_DIR%\rollback"

set "LOG_FILE=%LOG_DIR%\migration_%DATE:~10,4%%DATE:~4,2%%DATE:~7,2%_%TIME:~0,2%%TIME:~3,2%%TIME:~6,2%.log"
set "LOG_FILE=!LOG_FILE: =0!"

REM --- Get Current State ---
set "STATE=NOT_STARTED"
if exist "%STATE_FILE%" (
    for /f "tokens=2 delims==" %%a in ('findstr /i "STATE=" "%STATE_FILE%" 2^>nul') do set "STATE=%%a"
)

echo ==============================================================================
echo   OMNIROUTE PHASE 1: APPLICATION PACKAGE MIGRATION CONSOLE
echo   Linear Execution - Only Pauses on Errors or Fallbacks
echo ==============================================================================
echo.
echo Current State: %STATE%
echo.

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 1: AUDIT SYSTEM STATUS
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 1/8] AUDIT SYSTEM STATUS
echo.

set "CURRENT_TARGET=NOT_FOUND"
set "CURRENT_LINKTYPE=NONE"
if exist "%C_JUNCTION%" (
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "CURRENT_TARGET=%%t"
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LinkType" 2^>nul`) do set "CURRENT_LINKTYPE=%%t"
)

set "PROC_COUNT=0"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%p in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' }).Count" 2^>nul`) do set "PROC_COUNT=%%p"

set "PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "PORT_STATUS=%%o"

echo   C: Junction: %C_JUNCTION%
echo   Link Type: %CURRENT_LINKTYPE%
echo   Current Target: %CURRENT_TARGET%
echo   Port %PORT%: %PORT_STATUS%
echo   OmniRoute Processes: %PROC_COUNT%

if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%\package.json" (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Old source not found at: %OLD_SOURCE%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
echo.
echo   [OK] Old source found with package.json

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo   [WARN] Local destination already contains package.json
    echo   This could be from a previous incomplete migration.
) else (
    echo   [OK] Local destination is ready for staging
)

echo.
echo [STEP 1 COMPLETE] Audit passed. Proceeding to staging.
timeout /t 3 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 2: STAGE COPY (SAFE WHILE OMNIROUTE IS RUNNING)
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 2/8] STAGE COPY (non-destructive, runs while OmniRoute is active)
echo.
echo Source     : %OLD_SOURCE%
echo Destination: %LOCAL_DEST%
echo.

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%" mkdir "%LOCAL_DEST%"

echo Running robocopy to local destination...
robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"

if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Robocopy failed with code %RC_ERR%
    echo Check log: %LOG_FILE%
    echo.
    echo Press any key to review error and choose: [R]etry or [A]bort
    pause >nul
    goto STEP2_RETRY_OR_ABORT
)

echo.
echo Verifying staged files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
        echo [OK] Core files verified in local destination.
        echo STATE=STAGED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] bin\omniroute.mjs missing after staging!
        pause
        exit /b 1
    )
) else (
    echo [ERROR] package.json missing after staging!
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo.
echo [STEP 2 COMPLETE] Staging done. OmniRoute still running.
timeout /t 2 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 3: STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 3/8] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo.
echo WARNING: Stopping OmniRoute will disconnect Faust's live terminal.
echo.
echo Current Port %PORT% Status: %PORT_STATUS%
echo Active OmniRoute Processes: %PROC_COUNT%
echo.

if "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="CLOSED" (
        echo OmniRoute is already stopped. Skipping termination.
    ) else (
        echo [WARN] Port is closed but process count shows %PROC_COUNT%
        echo Proceeding anyway...
    )
) else (
    echo Terminating OmniRoute processes...
    if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
        for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do (
            echo Killing PID: %%i
            taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
        )
        del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
    )

    powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

    echo Waiting for services to stop...
    timeout /t 3 >nul

    set "PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "PORT_STATUS=%%o"

    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
        echo [ERROR] Port %PORT% still active after termination!
        echo Press any key to continue anyway or [Ctrl+C] to abort
        pause >nul

    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "CURRENT_TARGET=%%t"
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).LinkType" 2^>nul`) do set "CURRENT_LINKTYPE=%%t"
)

set "PROC_COUNT=0"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%p in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.CommandLine -match 'omniroute' }).Count" 2^>nul`) do set "PROC_COUNT=%%p"

set "PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "PORT_STATUS=%%o"

echo   C: Junction: %C_JUNCTION%
echo   Link Type: %CURRENT_LINKTYPE%
echo   Current Target: %CURRENT_TARGET%
echo   Port %PORT%: %PORT_STATUS%
echo   OmniRoute Processes: %PROC_COUNT%

if not exist "%OLD_SOURCE%\package.json" (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Old source not found at: %OLD_SOURCE%
    pause
    exit /b 1
)
echo.
echo   [OK] Old source found with package.json

if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    echo   [WARN] Local destination already contains package.json
    echo   This could be from a previous incomplete migration.
) else (
    echo   [OK] Local destination is ready for staging
)

echo.
echo [STEP 1 COMPLETE] Audit passed. Proceeding to staging.
timeout /t 3 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 2: STAGE COPY (SAFE WHILE OMNIROUTE IS RUNNING)
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 2/8] STAGE COPY (non-destructive, runs while OmniRoute is active)
echo.
echo Source     : %OLD_SOURCE%
echo Destination: %LOCAL_DEST%
echo.

if not exist "%LOCAL_DEST%" mkdir "%LOCAL_DEST%"

echo Running robocopy to local destination...
robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"

if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo.
    echo [ERROR] Robocopy failed with code %RC_ERR%
    echo Check log: %LOG_FILE%
    echo.
    echo Press any key to review error and choose: [R]etry or [A]bort
    pause >nul
    goto STEP2_RETRY_OR_ABORT
)

echo.
echo Verifying staged files...
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (
    if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (
        echo [OK] Core files verified in local destination.
        echo STATE=STAGED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] bin\omniroute.mjs missing after staging!
        pause
        exit /b 1
    )
) else (
    echo [ERROR] package.json missing after staging!
    pause
    exit /b 1
)

echo.
echo [STEP 2 COMPLETE] Staging done. OmniRoute still running.
timeout /t 2 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 3: STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 3/8] STOP OMNIROUTE SERVICE
echo.
echo WARNING: Stopping OmniRoute will disconnect Faust's live terminal.
echo.
echo Current Port %PORT% Status: %PORT_STATUS%
echo Active OmniRoute Processes: %PROC_COUNT%
echo.

if "%PROC_COUNT%"=="0" (
    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="CLOSED" (
        echo OmniRoute is already stopped. Skipping termination.
    ) else (
        echo [WARN] Port is closed but process count shows %PROC_COUNT%
        echo Proceeding anyway...
    )
) else (
    echo Terminating OmniRoute processes...
    if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
        for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do (
            echo Killing PID: %%i
            taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
        )
        del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
    )

    powershell -NoProfile -Command "Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.LocalPort -eq %PORT% } | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }" >nul 2>&1

    echo Waiting for services to stop...
    timeout /t 3 >nul

    set "PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "PORT_STATUS=%%o"

    if "%PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
        echo [ERROR] Port %PORT% still active after termination!
        echo Press any key to continue anyway or [Ctrl+C] to abort
        pause >nul
    ) else (
        echo [OK] OmniRoute stopped cleanly. Port %PORT% is closed.
    )
)

echo.
echo [STEP 3 COMPLETE] OmniRoute stopped. Proceeding to cutover.
timeout /t 2 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 4: EXECUTE CUTOVER
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 4/8] EXECUTE CUTOVER
echo.

echo Current C: Junction Target: %CURRENT_TARGET%

if not "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%OLD_SOURCE%" (
    if "%CURRENT_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
        echo [INFO] C: Junction already points to Local Destination.
        echo Cutover appears complete from previous run.
        goto STEP5_VERIFY
    ) else (
        echo [ERROR] C: Junction target does not match expected!
        echo Expected: %OLD_SOURCE%
        echo Current: %CURRENT_TARGET%
        echo.
        echo Press any key to continue and review, or [Ctrl+C] to abort
        pause >nul
    )
)

echo [4a/4] Running final delta robocopy...
robocopy "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%LOCAL_DEST%" /E /COPY:DAT /DCOPY:DAT /XJ /R:2 /W:2 /TEE /LOG+:"%LOG_FILE%"
set "RC_ERR=%ERRORLEVEL%"
if %RC_ERR% GEQ 8 (
    echo [ERROR] Delta copy failed with code %RC_ERR%
    echo Press any key to continue or [Ctrl+C] to abort
    pause >nul
)

echo [4b/4] Moving old Drive package to local rollback...
if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
    echo [ERROR] Rollback directory already exists: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    echo Press any key to continue and review, or [Ctrl+C] to abort
    pause >nul
) else (
    move "%OLD_SOURCE%" "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
    if errorlevel 1 (
        echo [ERROR] Failed to move old package to rollback!
        echo Press any key to continue or [Ctrl+C] to abort
        pause >nul
    ) else (
        echo [OK] Old package moved to: %ROLLBACK_DIR%
    )
)

echo [4c/4] Removing old C: junction...
rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to remove C: junction!
    echo Press any key to continue or [Ctrl+C] to abort
    pause >nul
) else (
    echo [OK] Old junction removed.
)

echo [4d/4] Creating new C: junction to Local Destination...
mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%LOCAL_DEST%"
if errorlevel 1 (
    echo [ERROR] Failed to create new junction!
    echo Attempting to restore old package from rollback...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"
    echo Press any key to continue or [Ctrl+C] to abort
    pause >nul
) else (
    echo [OK] New junction created.

    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_TARGET=%%t"

    if "%NEW_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
        echo [OK] New C: Junction correctly points to: %NEW_TARGET%
    ) else (
        echo [WARN] C: Junction target is: %NEW_TARGET%
    )
)

echo STATE=CUTOVER_COMPLETE > "%STATE_FILE%"
echo CUTOVER_TIME=%DATE% %TIME% >> "%STATE_FILE%"

echo.
echo [STEP 4 COMPLETE] Cutover done. Proceeding to verification.
timeout /t 2 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 5: VERIFY CUTOVER
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 5/8] VERIFY CUTOVER STATIC INTEGRITY
echo.

set "V_TARGET=NOT_FOUND"
for /f "usebackq delims=" %%t in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "(Get-Item -LiteralPath '%C_JUNCTION%' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Target" 2^>nul`) do set "V_TARGET=%%t"

echo 1. C: Junction Target: %V_TARGET%
if "%V_TARGET%"=="%LOCAL_DEST%" (
    echo    [OK] Correct target.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] Expected: %LOCAL_DEST%
)

echo 2. Essential Files Check:
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\package.json" (echo    [OK] package.json)
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" (echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs)
if exist "%LOCAL_DEST%\node_modules" (echo    [OK] node_modules)

echo 3. Node.js Availability:
where node >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    for /f "delims=" %%v in ('node -v 2^>nul') do echo    [OK] Node.js: %%v
) else (
    echo    [WARN] Node not in PATH.
)

echo 4. Syntax Check:
node --check "%LOCAL_DEST%\bin\omniroute.mjs" >nul 2>&1
if %ERRORLEVEL% equ 0 (
    echo    [OK] bin\omniroute.mjs syntax OK.
) else (
    echo    [FAIL] Syntax check failed!
)

echo.
echo [STEP 5 COMPLETE] Verification done.
timeout /t 2 >nul

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 6: START OMNIROUTE SERVICE (WAKES FAUST)
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 6/8] START OMNIROUTE SERVICE (WAKES FAUST)
echo.
echo Launching OmniRoute from new local location...
echo %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
echo.

if exist "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%" (
    call "%OMNI_SHORTCUT%"
    echo Waiting 5 seconds for service to bind to Port %PORT%...
    timeout /t 5 >nul

    set "NEW_PORT_STATUS=CLOSED"
    for /f "usebackq delims=" %%o in (`powershell -NoProfile -Command "if (Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort %PORT% -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { 'LISTENING' } else { 'CLOSED' }" 2^>nul`) do set "NEW_PORT_STATUS=%%o"

    if "%NEW_PORT_STATUS%"=="LISTENING" (
        echo.
        echo [OK] OmniRoute is LISTENING on Port %PORT%!
        echo [OK] Faust connection should be restored.
        echo STATE=VERIFIED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    ) else (
        echo.
        echo [WARN] Port %PORT% not open yet. Check logs.
        echo[state=STARTED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    )
) else (
    echo [ERROR] Launcher not found: %OMNI_SHORTCUT%
    echo STATE=START_FAILED > "%STATE_FILE%"
)

echo.
echo [STEP 6 COMPLETE] OmniRoute launch initiated.

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 7: ROLLBACK (IF NEEDED - ONLY RUN THIS IF OMNIROUTE FAILS TO START)
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 7] ROLLBACK OPTION (only run if OmniRoute failed to start)
echo.
echo To roll back to original setup, type: CONFIRM ROLLBACK
set /p "RB_PHRASE=Optionally type to rollback: "
if "%RB_PHRASE%"=="CONFIRM ROLLBACK" (
    echo.
    echo [ROLLBACK] Stopping any active OmniRoute...
    if exist "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" (
        for /f "usebackq delims=" %%i in ("%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid") do taskkill /PID %%i /T /F >nul 2>&1
        del "%PID_DIR%\omniroute.pid" >nul 2>&1
    )

    echo [ROLLBACK] Removing current C: junction...
    rmdir "%C_JUNCTION%" >nul 2>&1

    echo [ROLLBACK] Moving package back from rollback to Drive source...
    move "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"

    echo [ROLLBACK] Recreating original C: junction...
    mklink /J "%C_JUNCTION%" "%OLD_SOURCE%"

    echo [ROLLBACK] Restored. Type "RECOVER" after OmniRoute restarts to continue.
    echo STATE=ROLLED_BACK > "%STATE_FILE%"
    pause
)

REM ==============================================================================
REM   STEP 8: FINALIZE
echo ==============================================================================
echo [STEP 8] FINALIZE (delete rollback backup after 48h+ stable operation)
echo.
echo To permanently delete rollback backup, type: DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP
set /p "FIN_PHRASE=Optionally finalize: "
if "%FIN_PHRASE%"=="DELETE ROLLBACK BACKUP" (
    if exist "%ROLLBACK_DIR%" (
        rmdir /S /Q "%ROLLBACK_DIR%"
        echo [FINALIZE] Rollback backup deleted.
        echo STATE=FINALIZED > "%STATE_FILE%"
    ) else (
        echo [INFO] No rollback backup exists.
    )
)

echo.
echo ==============================================================================
echo   PHASE 1 COMPLETED
echo ==============================================================================
echo   State: %STATE%
echo   Log: %LOG_FILE%
echo.
pause
